chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) would take hold of the beginning of the speech, rather than its end.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What was Imam Ali's method of listening to speech according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* illustrates Imam Ali’s (peace be upon him) jurisprudential and rhetorical strategy of anchoring meaning in the opening declaration, a method that prevents ambiguity often found in lengthy elaborations. In Shia scholarly tradition, this reflects the principle of prioritizing the clear, initial intent (*al-awwal*) to ensure accurate legal and ethical interpretation, mirroring the prophetic emphasis on concise and direct communication.
